papers.title: Ironing out the wrinkles
papers.summary: Nature Energy, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02127-1Ultrawide-bandgap perovskites are essential for all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells, yet their high bromide content causes surface wrinkling and halide disorder, limiting the performance. A surface reconstruction and halide homogenization strategy now enables a certified efficiency of 29.3% in all-perovskite triple-junction devices.
papers.authors: Tomoya Nakamura, Minh Anh Truong, Atsushi Wakamiya
papers.research_story:
该工作针对全钙钛矿三结电池中超宽禁带钙钛矿因高溴含量引发的表面起皱与卤化物无序问题。

作者提出表面重构与卤化物均质化协同策略，通过调控表面化学环境抑制应力诱导的形貌失稳并促进卤素均匀分布。

机理上，表面重构缓解了晶格失配与残余应力，卤化物均质化则降低了局域组分波动与缺陷密度。

最终实现29.3%的认证效率，为全钙钛矿三结电池最高值之一。

该策略为高溴超宽禁带钙钛矿的缺陷与稳定性调控提供了可推广路径，推动三结叠层器件向实用化迈进。

papers.title: Crystallization control of 2.0-eV bandgap perovskites for all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells
papers.summary: Ultrawide-bandgap (UWBG) perovskites are essential for monolithic all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells. However, their performance is limited by severe surface wrinkling, halide heterogeneity and large open-circuit voltage deficits originating from high Br–I ratios. Here we develop a surface reconstruction and halide homogenization strategy that simultaneously regulates crystallization and eliminates stress-induced morphological disorder in 2.0-eV bandgap perovskites. Through synergistic solvent and additive engineering, involving solvent-induced surface reconstruction and transient Cl− incorporation from oleylammonium chloride, surface wrinkling is suppressed, and Br/I crystallization is synchronized with promoted homogeneous halide distribution. The resulting UWBG perovskite films show uniform surface potential, suppressed non-radiative recombination, improved carrier mobility and an open-circuit voltage of 1.46 V. Integrating this UWBG subcell with optimized 1.6- and 1.22-eV absorbers yields monolithic all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells with 30.1% power conversion efficiency (certified 29.3%) and robust operational stability, providing a promising route towards >35% efficient all-perovskite multijunction photovoltaics.
papers.authors: Yuhong Zhang, Enzuo Wang, Haonan Liu et al.
papers.research_story:
该工作针对全钙钛矿三结电池中2.0 eV超宽带隙子电池因高Br/I比导致的表面起皱、卤化物偏析及开压亏损等瓶颈。

作者提出溶剂诱导表面重构与油胺氯化物瞬态Cl⁻掺入的协同策略，同步调控结晶动力学并消除应力诱导的形貌无序，实现Br/I同步结晶与卤素均质化。

机理上，该策略抑制非辐射复合、提升载流子迁移率并均化表面电势，获得1.46 V开压。

相比同类UWBG器件，其结晶质量与光电性能显著提升，为三结叠层提供了可行子电池方案，推动了全钙钛矿多结光伏的实用化进程。

papers.title: Uniform film formation helps tandem solar cells work better for longer
papers.summary: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02709-9When making mixed-halide perovskite films for use in solar cells, bromide-rich domains crystallize faster than iodide-rich ones do, leading to defects. Adding a molecule tuned to bind selectively to bromide-bound lead synchronizes the crystallization rates, yielding uniform films, better operating stability and a more-efficient perovskite–organic tandem.
papers.research_story:
混合卤化物钙钛矿中溴富集相与碘富集相结晶动力学失配，导致组分偏析与缺陷密度升高，制约钙钛矿–有机叠层电池的效率与运行稳定性。

该工作引入可选择性配位溴结合铅的调控分子，同步两相结晶速率，实现组分均匀的钙钛矿薄膜。

机理上，选择性配位抑制了溴富集畴的优先成核，使卤素分布均一化并降低界面与体相缺陷密度。

基于此，叠层器件在效率与运行稳定性上同步提升，优于未调控的混合卤素体系。

该策略为卤素均一化提供了动力学调控范式，对叠层光伏的长期稳定性研究具有实质性推进意义。
